name: Easy Pressure Cooker Beef Barbacoa Rice Bowl with Creamy Slaw, Avocado & Lime

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Mince 1 chipotle pepper. Place both in a 6-quart pressure cooker insert along with broth, vinegar, garlic, 1 tbsp adobo sauce from the can, soy sauce, tomato paste, and spices. Stir to combine the sauce. (Reserve remaining chipotles for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow onion
1 (7 oz) can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
1 cup beef broth
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp chili powder
2 tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat beef roast dry with paper towels and cut into 4 equal-sized pieces. Add to the pressure cooker, nestling the meat into the sauce. Lock lid and set pressure to cook on HIGH for 50 minutes. Once done, allow the pressure to release naturally for 20 minutes, then carefully release any remaining pressure and remove the lid.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 lb beef bottom round roast, boneless

instructions.primary_message: After opening the pressure cooker, using tongs, transfer beef to a plate and set aside. Set pressure cooker to sauté on HIGH and let the sauce simmer and reduce, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the sides.

Meanwhile, working one at a time, place rice pouches in the microwave, seam-side up. Heat on high for 3-4 minutes (until pouch balloons up with steam for 30 seconds). Allow steam to vent before opening pouch. (Alternatively, rice can be heated in a saucepan according to package instructions.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (10 oz) pouch frozen brown rice, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: Place shredded cabbage and dressing in a large bowl, then stir to combine the slaw. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (14 oz) bag shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
⅔ cup coleslaw dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry avocado and lime. Using a clean cutting board, halve and pit avocado, scoop out the flesh, and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Cut lime into wedges. Set both aside.
Use two forks to shred the beef into bite-sized pieces. Return to the pressure cooker with the reduced sauce, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide rice, slaw, shredded beef, sauce, and avocado between bowls. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
